social.text: The golden ratio in cinematography 🎬 The golden ratio (about 1.618) is a composition guide with two common forms: the Phi Grid and the Golden Spiral. The Phi Grid looks like the rule of thirds, but its sections are unequal, so the intersections sit slightly closer to the center. The spiral guides the eye toward the subject. It’s a guide, not a law. Try both and trust your eye. # Cinematography # Filmmaking # GoldenRatio # Composition # FilmTechnique
